about.text: The work of the Student Service Center (SSC) aims to raise service recipients' satisfaction with the quality of public services, to create conditions for the openness and transparency of the educational process, and to reduce the time college students spend obtaining the certificates they need.
about.goal: to provide services based on a client-oriented approach, and to serve students quickly and to a high standard under the "one-stop shop" principle.
